title: OntologyCatalogue
description: Schema for a list of ontologies used in CELINE.

prefix.description: CURIE prefix for this ontology, e.g. 'sosa'. With `namespace`, makes this file the prefix->namespace authority for consumers that expand CURIEs (dataset-api derives its JSON-LD contexts from it). Optional: an ontology can be catalogued without being addressable by prefix.

namespace.description: Namespace IRI the prefix expands to, including its trailing '#' or '/'. Required alongside `prefix` — a prefix without a namespace expands to nothing.

definitions.description: List of URIs to XML/TTL/OWL/specification file.

keywords.description: List of domain and entity keywords associated with the ontology.

prefixes.description: Base vocabularies that CELINE terms are written against but that are not domain ontologies to catalogue: xsd, rdf, rdfs, dct, owl, skos and the CELINE namespace itself. They belong here rather than in `ontologies` because keywords, license and homepage say nothing useful about xsd, yet a consumer expanding a CURIE still has to resolve it. Kept in this file so there is one prefix authority, not two.
